pre_search_revision_note: Before candidate scoring, timestamp provenance was checked against source code and rows; daily/hourly summaries are limited to the explicitly populated legacy platform_timestamp field and labeled unverified.

target.ideal_net_profit_per_unit_staked: 1 on hit; -1 on miss; zero expected value at a 50% hit rate before costs

source.current_postgresql_status: UNAVAILABLE_AT_RUN_START; use this immutable extracted snapshot until PostgreSQL is reachable

analysis_population.descriptive_values: all rows marked kept by the existing audited clean set; report also raw-source counts and the verified-order subset
analysis_population.identity_limit: These records have overlap-verified relative order only. There are no platform_round_id or platform_round_index values in the snapshot. Do not claim platform identity or prospective confirmation from this archive.
analysis_population.sequence_order: round_index is used only inside rows marked overlap-verified; local index alone is never accepted as continuity proof.
segment_breaks: continuity_verified or HISTORY_SNAPSHOT_OVERLAP proof is absent
a raw round_index value is missing between retained rows and the skipped index was not an audited dropped overlap row
analysis_population.overlap_cleaning: Use the recorded D1/D2/D3 cleaning decisions from the existing audit. Preserve adjacent equal multipliers; never drop rows by multiplier equality alone. Do not infer timestamps for batch rows.

timestamp_analysis.use: Provide daily and UTC-hour descriptive summaries only for retained rows with this explicit field. Mark the summaries as unverified legacy timestamp diagnostics. Do not use timestamps for candidate features, order, continuity, or prospective claims.

chronological_split.method: floor cut points at 60% and 80% of 4297 ordered rows; no random shuffle
chronological_split.context_rule: Features may use earlier rows from the same verified segment, including across split boundaries. No feature may read the target outcome or future rows. Never carry context across a segment break.
contamination_evidence: backend/reports/statistical_engine_v1_historical_report.json inspected the historical archive through round_index 21103 and declares its 60/40 results exploratory, not confirmatory.
backend/trained_models/ml-20261006T170129Z-e8634a31-random_forest/metadata.json records model candidate evaluation using data through round_index 22604, overlapping the planned latest 20% period.
chronological_split.confirmatory_test: Not available in this archive. Collect genuinely new rounds after this plan and shortlist are frozen; use those only for prospective confirmation.

rolling_hit_counts_and_rates.integer_count_cutoffs: all counts from 0 through window length, using <= and >=; remove duplicate predicates

support_and_scoring.confidence_intervals: Wilson 95% for hit rates; moving-block bootstrap 95% for net return/lift
baseline_comparison: unconditional >=2.00x rate in the same evaluation period
break-even probability 0.50 and idealized net return 2p-1
random-entry policies with identical selection count
support_and_scoring.model_comparison: No logistic regression or tree is fit in this rule-only search. Compare against no-bet, unconditional, and matched-coverage random-entry baselines.

false_discovery_control.discovery_correction: Holm step-down over every unique predeclared candidate

dependence_test.method: circular shifts of outcomes within each verified segment
dependence_test.assumption: approximate stationarity within a verified segment under the no-association null

false_discovery_control.stopping_rule: Run exactly the registered candidate family and replicate counts once. If inputs fail hash, row-count, continuity, or budget checks, stop without candidate scoring. No post-test retuning.

ranking: validation idealized net return per unit, descending
discovery idealized net return per unit, descending
shortlist_freeze.purpose: Produce a fixed exploratory shortlist even if every candidate is negative; status remains EDGE_UNVERIFIED or INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

requires_all: positive discovery lift versus both same-period baseline and 50% break-even
positive lift in all four walk-forward folds
validation support >= 100 and positive lift versus both validation baseline and break-even
positive lower 95% moving-block-bootstrap bound in discovery and validation
retrospective final support >= 100 and positive lift versus both final baseline and break-even
historical_edge_gate.reason: The latest archive period was used in prior model candidate evaluation and rows have order-only, not platform identity, evidence.

session_backtest.entry: Trigger calculated after source round; bet only the next eligible round; settle on that round before any subsequent entry.
session_backtest.stop_rule: STOP until next session when any configured session loss, consecutive-loss, or profit-goal limit is reached.
session_backtest.discontinuity: STOP and reset session; do not place an entry whose source or target crosses a segment boundary.
execution_sensitivity_scenarios: 5% and 10% of eligible entries fail to place and are not staked
1% of wins fail settlement and are treated as losses
effective winning payout of 1.98x instead of 2.00x
session_backtest.assumption_label: Ideal historical settlement; no live placement or cashout is verified. Scenario parameters are examples, not user-selected bankroll advice.
